ov: مادن (الإنجليزية: Madden) هو فلم سيرة ذاتية رياضي أمريكي قادم، أخرجه ديفيد أو. راسل، وشارك في إنتاجه وكتابة السيناريو استنادًا إلى نسخة سابقة كتبها كامبرون كلارك. يتتبع الفلم حياة مدرب كرة القدم الأمريكية والمعلّق الرياضي جون مادن، ويؤدي نيكولاس كيج دوره. ويشارك في بطولته أيضًا كريستيان بيل وكاثرين هان وجون مولايني وسينا ميلير وشين غيليس.
plotEn: Madden depicts the life and career of John Madden, from his tenure as head coach of the Oakland Raiders and his relationship with team owner Al Davis to his transition into sports broadcasting and his role in developing the Madden NFL video game franchise. The story explores Madden's friendship and professional partnership with Davis, including the Raiders' victory in Super Bowl XI, as well as the personal and professional challenges surrounding his retirement from coaching. After leaving the sidelines, Madden becomes a television commentator before collaborating with Electronic Arts founder Trip Hawkins to create a football simulation video game. The film also depicts Madden's marriage to Virginia and Davis's relationship with his wife, Carol, while examining how Madden's personality and approach to football shaped his subsequent career.
